geometryBasis: The 31-vertex OpenStreetMap outline supplies the whole site envelope, roundabout elevation, two tower projections, entrance and rear volume. The join separating the historic hall and expansion is approximate.
sectionBasis: The cleared CC0 side view establishes the green dome, rusticated lower storey, stone trim and red brick upper register, repeated windows and red rear roof. The museum and restoration architect document paired towers, copper mansards and dormers.
